integration_notes: modelKey/speciesId are stable lookup keys; MonsterKind 3-8 must never be used as legacy ModelLibrary::Monster indices 3-4.
Basic attack and special event times match current simulation windups. Events are visual notifications only; do not apply damage/heal twice.

Travel/charge/pounce are in-place; AI remains responsible for world translation and hit tests.
Demon wings are folded ground-animation appendages; no flight gameplay or summoning implemented.
Existing v3 base assets and game source are not changed by this new pack.
